fact: The GRAIN comparative study, presented 10 August 2026, says Burkina Faso does not yet have a dedicated national AI strategy and recommends developing one.

Burkina Faso's national AI roadmap 2026-2030 was validated on 19 June 2026 after ten months of work, and its official publication is still awaited, according to Dr Yaya Traore of the digital-transition ministry.
